documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Pelham Annals (fictional).
In this document "PA-MS" means Pelham Annals. Pelham Annals reports witness count of 49 for FY2024 on a reported basis. Pelham Annals reports quire count of 8. Pelham Annals: number of surviving folios for FY2024 — not provided. Pelham Annals reports line count of 28 for FY2024. For Pelham Annals, the meaning of the term "ordo" in book II is read as: a liturgical order of service. For Pelham Annals, the place of origin is: copied in the southern scriptorium.
